name: DS Cluster S45: is_asset_ref (Asset Filtering)
description: Tests: is_asset_ref by ticker, exclude_ticker, sector, base_currency. where() gating pattern.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S45: is_asset_ref Patterns
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === FILTER BY TICKER ===
is_spy = is_asset_ref(ticker="SPY")()
spy_only = where(is_spy, close)

# === EXCLUDE TICKER ===
not_spy = is_asset_ref(exclude_ticker="SPY")()
non_spy = where(not_spy, close)

# === FILTER BY SECTOR (Stocks only) ===
is_tech = is_asset_ref(sector=StockSector.Information_Technology)()
tech_rets = where(is_tech, rets)

# === WEIGHTED BY FILTER ===
weight = where(is_spy, 2.0, 1.0)
weighted_ret = rets * weight

# === REPORTERS ===
histogram(
    title="Tech Sector Returns",
    category="Asset Filter",
    bins=30
)(tech_rets)

cards(
    category="Asset Filter",
    layout=CardLayout(title="is_asset_ref Results", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="is_spy", card_agg=AggregationType.First, type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title="is_tech", card_agg=AggregationType.First, type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
    ])
)((is_spy, is_tech))
